command_char.description: The control character to enter command mode in splitvt.

quote_char.description: The control character to quote the next character typed.

switch_char.description: The control character to switch focus between upper and lower windows.

upper_lines.description: The number of lines to allocate to the upper window.

login_mode.description: Whether to run the shells as login shells (on/off).

upper_command.description: List of commands to run in the upper window. Supports multiple entries if needed, but typically one shell.

lower_command.description: List of commands to run in the lower window. Supports multiple entries.
